ui_002.message: Connect your personal ChatGPT once. Then manage conversations by talking to ChatGPT.

ui_010.message: Set up or replace the key

ui_011.message: You need an OpenAI tunnel and the Chat Commander app configured in your ChatGPT. Use a dedicated runtime key, not an Admin key.

ui_014.message: Remember the encrypted key on this device

ui_015.message: Choose a local password (at least 12 characters)

ui_017.message: The password unlocks the key after a restart and is not saved by the extension. If you forget it, enter the API key again. Encryption protects the saved file, not a compromised browser or computer.

ui_020.message: Automatically reconnect to the same account

ui_021.message: The browser requests access to chatgpt.com. Chat contents and cookies are not stored on disk. Every change requires confirmation inside ChatGPT.

ui_026.message: If needed, connect the Chat Commander app to your tunnel. After a tool update, use Manage → Refresh tools in the ChatGPT app. You do not need to repeat this on every startup.

setup_001.message: Connect Chat Commander one step at a time. After restarting, begin by unlocking your saved key.

setup_003.message: This key lets the extension receive requests from your ChatGPT app. You need an existing private OpenAI tunnel and its dedicated runtime key. Installing the extension does not create them.

setup_004.message: Already saved your key? Unlock it here with your local password. This is not your ChatGPT password and is not sent to OpenAI.

setup_005.message: Follow the OpenAI guide to create a tunnel and key

setup_008.message: Key ready. Continue to step 2: connect your ChatGPT tab.

setup_010.message: Open ChatGPT, sign in to your personal account and wait for the page to load. Return here and choose the tab to connect: the extension uses it to read chats and verify requested changes.

setup_011.message: The browser will ask for access to chatgpt.com. The connection result appears directly below the button. The connected tab is protected from moves and deletion.

setup_012.message: Complete step 1 first. Then you can choose and connect a tab.

setup_013.message: No tab available. Open ChatGPT below, sign in and return to this page.

setup_015.message: Permission denied. To connect the tab, click the button again and allow access to chatgpt.com.

setup_016.message: Connecting the tab… The result will appear here.

setup_019.message: Complete steps 1 and 2 first. Test the app connection inside ChatGPT, rather than saving the key again.

setup_020.message: Connect the Chat Commander app to your tunnel once in ChatGPT settings. After a tool update, use Manage → Refresh tools. If the app is already connected and up to date, do not recreate it.

setup_021.message: Then send this message in your ChatGPT conversation. The list and any errors will appear in the chat: that is where you verify the full connection.

setup_022.message: I have connected the app and refreshed its tools

setup_023.message: App marked as configured. Now try the message in ChatGPT: this acknowledgement is not a tool test.

setup_024.message: After restarting: unlock your key, open an authenticated ChatGPT tab and wait to reconnect to the same account. If it does not reconnect, return to step 2.

setup_026.message: Locking stops the tunnel and requires the password again. Forgetting also removes the saved encrypted key: you will need to enter the runtime key again.

setup_028.message: Saving… The result will appear here.

setup_029.message: Unlocking… The result will appear here.

setup_waiting.message: Waiting for ChatGPT to fetch the current tools and complete a tool call. No manual acknowledgement is needed.

setup_catalog_observed.message: Current tool catalog fetched at $1. Now run the read-only test below.

setup_tool_observed.message: Successful tool call: $1 at $2. Check its results in the ChatGPT conversation.

setup_personal_only.message: Select an unambiguous personal ChatGPT profile. Business or multiple-workspace sessions are not supported.
